inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev26 whole-MESH/ARRY graph synchronization, dev25 retail GMX evidence, GUI baseline, mod-package/workspace, native-builder, research, extraction and source-only gates are inherited. Dev27 adds opt-in BONE/PARE/MTRL/SHAD scene relationships and a visual scene report without modifying dev26.

dev27_gmx_scene_graph_sync.default_behavior: dev25/dev26-compatible template and mesh-graph modes remain available; full scene synchronization is opt-in
proven_regression: new donor-schema MTRL with edited DiffuseColor
new BONE with material/mesh attachments and imported transform
new complete MESH/ARRY graph through inherited dev26 compiler
dev27_gmx_scene_graph_sync.inherited_external_retail_gate: dev25 306/306 mesh-bearing GMX no-op byte-identical plus plr_001 topology smoke
dev27_gmx_scene_graph_sync.boundary: Scene synthesis is structurally regression-tested. Mesh/material layouts still clone compatible native donors; TXIF creation, arbitrary schemas, platform shader compilation, broader animation graph synthesis, template-free GMX construction and arbitrary synthesized-scene runtime acceptance remain unresolved.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no missing/mismatched/unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, then passed 73/73 selftests and CLI/GUI version checks. The final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and is revalidated separately.

limitations: Dev27 SHAD/MTRL/BONE/PARE scene synthesis is structurally regression-tested but has not yet been exercised as an arbitrary synthesized scene on retail hardware/emulator.
Synthesized MESH/ARRY nodes and MTRL parameter schemas clone compatible native donor layouts; arbitrary vertex declarations and material parameter schemas are not implemented.
SHAD synthesis covers the known fixed native identity/name/flags record; platform shader bytecode compilation is not implemented.
TXIF creation is not implemented, so genuinely new texture-binding graph synthesis still requires compatible template resources.
Existing BONE transform bytes are preserved unless explicit transform import is requested; MOTN/ANIM graph synthesis remains template-owned.
The external dev25 retail 306/306 no-op and plr_001 topology evidence is inherited rather than re-bundled or re-run from proprietary inputs in this release tree.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
Audio replacement/rebuilding remains intentionally deferred by current project priority.
